'''Vergesso I''' was one of five valueless [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid rings]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|yellow star]] [[Lybeya]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Lybeya system/Legends|Lybeya system]]. The five [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] fields, which comprised the larger [[Vergesso Asteroids/Legends|Vergesso Asteroids]], were the sundered remains of [[Planet/Legends|planets]], created by some unknown force, possibly an encounter with a rogue star. Vergesso I contained one major [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]].
